name: Mamiya Hisako
source:
Occupation: Journalist
Stay as: Guest

A woman from Kanto, Hisako is a freelance writer who travels across Japan in search of local culinary specialties.

She works with [url=/c87413]Yuudai[/url] and stays at the lodge in Kamifujiyoshi.
